name: Medicine Tracker
label: Client project · Mobile PWA
description: Phone-first app a pet owner uses every day to track each pet's medicine. Tick off morning and evening doses, add remarks, get push reminders, and export the full history to CSV.
note: Demo uses sample pets. The client's real app stays private.

description: Animated digital wedding invitation with an opening seal, live countdown, five colour themes, RSVP and guest wishes, plus a PIN-protected admin page for the guest list.

name: Attendance Tracker
label: Personal project · QR check-in
description: Mobile check-in form for events. Guests scan a QR code, enter their name and address, and each check-in is saved as a new row in a private Google Sheet. The Google login stays on the server, so it never reaches the browser.
note: The live form saves to a real sheet, so only screenshots are shown here.
